{{Quote|Rogue Leader, this is Rescue 1. We're in position over the first Imperial transport. Evacuating prisoners now.|''Rescue 1'' to Wedge Antilles|<ref name="Rebel Strike" />}}
'''''Rescue 1''''' was the callsign of a [[GR-75 medium transport/Legends|GR-75 medium transport]] that served the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
During the Alliance [[raid at Bakura]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="Bakura" /> ''Rescue 1'', alongside [[Rescue 2 (GR-75 medium transport)|''Rescue 2'']] and [[Rescue 3 (GR-75 medium transport)|''Rescue 3'']], evacuated freed [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] from fleeing [[Imperial Action transport|Imperial Action transports]] under the protection of [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]].<ref name="Rebel Strike" />

Later, during a prisoner rescue operation on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]], Rogue Squadron fell into an [[Battle of Geonosis (Galactic Civil War)|Imperial ambush]]. The squadron commander, [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]], ordered all rescue transports to abort, but ''Rescue 1'' was destroyed by an [[Imperial escort carrier (storm commando)|Imperial escort carrier]] as it powered up its [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]].<ref name="Rebel Strike" />

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron III: Rebel Strike]]''
